title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 7
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q061_against_the_odds
elements.title: Their injury-hit team entered the final as an outsider but won ___.

elements.name: q062_makeshift
elements.title: Staff used tables and sheets to put together a ___ shelter until proper tents arrived.

elements.name: q063_negligence
elements.title: The report found ___: staff had failed to carry out basic safety checks, and someone was hurt.

elements.name: q064_downfall
elements.title: Once the fraud was revealed, the director's rapid ___ ended a career that had seemed secure.

elements.name: q065_malaise
elements.title: A general feeling of low energy and unease settled over the office. Which word describes it?

elements.name: q066_a_hard_act_to_follow
elements.title: The retiring coach won five trophies. Her successor will have a hard act to follow. What does that mean?
choices: It will be difficult to understand her instructions.
It will be difficult to match her success.
She will choose who takes over the team.
She will still coach the team behind the scenes.
elements.correctAnswer: It will be difficult to match her success.

elements.name: q067_full_circle
elements.title: After travelling the world for years, Mia returned to teach at her old school. Her career had come ___.

elements.name: q068_spin
elements.title: When asked about falling sales, the company tried to ___ the numbers as a sign of a healthier business.

elements.name: q069_tacit
elements.title: No one said yes aloud, but their willingness to proceed signalled ___ approval.

elements.name: q070_put_something_or_someone_to_the_test
elements.title: The long hike will put their new boots ___: the terrain will show whether the boots are durable.
